tagline.en: Wan2.2-Fun 5B Control Camera — a lighter camera-controlled image-to-video model from Alibaba PAI's VideoX-Fun.
tagline.zh: Wan2.2-Fun 5B Control Camera——出自阿里 PAI VideoX-Fun 的轻量级镜头可控图生视频模型。

en: Wan2.2-Fun 5B Control Camera is a camera-controlled video model from Alibaba PAI's VideoX-Fun project, built on the Wan2.2 lineage. It generates video from an input image while letting you steer the virtual camera.

At 5B this is the more compact option in the Wan2.2-Fun camera-control family, trading some capacity for a lighter footprint. You give it a starting image and a camera trajectory, and it renders a clip that follows that viewpoint; the upstream native profile runs 121 frames at 24 fps.
In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline, providing the image and camera path; the checkpoint route is wired for camera-conditioned image-to-video.
zh: Wan2.2-Fun 5B Control Camera 是阿里 PAI 的 VideoX-Fun 项目推出的镜头可控视频模型,构建在 Wan2.2 脉络之上。它从输入图片生成视频,同时让你操控虚拟相机。
5B 规模是 Wan2.2-Fun 相机控制家族中更紧凑的选项,以部分容量换取更轻的占用。你给它一张起始图片和一条相机轨迹,它便渲染出沿该视角运动的片段;上游原生规格为 121 帧、24 fps。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行它,提供图片与相机路径;该 checkpoint 路径为镜头条件化的图生视频而接入。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want camera-driven image-to-video with a lighter model — deliberate camera moves from a starting frame at lower cost than the 14B options.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用更轻的模型做以相机为主导的图生视频时用它——从起始帧出发做刻意的相机运动,成本低于 14B 选项。

notFor.en: The smaller 5B model may trade off fidelity versus larger camera-control checkpoints. Requires the checkpoint to be downloaded before use.
notFor.zh: 更小的 5B 模型在保真度上可能不及更大的相机控制 checkpoint。使用前需先下载 checkpoint。

en: Upstream native profile: 121 frames at 24 fps
From Alibaba PAI's VideoX-Fun, built on Wan2.2
